heroBody: With friends, flatmates and trips. Add an expense or scan a receipt — deun works out who owes whom, down to the cent. No paywalls, no premium tiers.
featLead: Receipt scanning, group expenses, fair splitting — everything you need, completely free.
featSplitBody: Split equally, by shares, by percentage or exact amounts. deun works out who owes what — down to the cent.
featGroupBody: Create groups for trips, flat shares or any occasion. Invite friends with a link and track expenses together.
featScanBody: Snap a photo of any receipt and deun pulls out the items — tap to claim what's yours. No manual entry needed.
featFreeBody: Every feature, no paywalls. No premium tier, no feature gates — just small native ads. Your data stays yours.
compareLead: Other apps lock features behind paywalls. deun doesn't.
howLead: No tutorials needed. Get started in under a minute.
howStep1Body: Name your group and invite friends with a share link. Everyone joins in seconds.
howStep2Body: Log who paid and how to split it — equal, shares, percentage or exact. Or just scan the receipt.
howStep3Body: See who owes whom at a glance. Mark debts settled when paid. Done.
dlLead: Scan a QR code or tap to download — free on iOS and Android.
